fullDescription.text: User-controlled data reaches a SQL query without parameterization

help.text: Use prepared statements with bound parameters ($wpdb->prepare(), PDO::prepare + bindValue). Never concatenate user input into SQL.
help.markdown: Use prepared statements with bound parameters ($wpdb->prepare(), PDO::prepare + bindValue). Never concatenate user input into SQL.

help.text: Use json_decode() instead. If unserialize() is required, pass ['allowed_classes' => false].
help.markdown: Use json_decode() instead. If unserialize() is required, pass ['allowed_classes' => false].

tags: A08:2021 - Software and Data Integrity Failures

fullDescription.text: User-controlled data reaches OS command execution

help.text: Avoid passing user input to OS commands. Use escapeshellarg() on every argument if unavoidable, and prefer proc_open with an argument array.
help.markdown: Avoid passing user input to OS commands. Use escapeshellarg() on every argument if unavoidable, and prefer proc_open with an argument array.

fullDescription.text: User-controlled data determines included file path (LFI/RFI)

help.text: Use a whitelist of allowed files. Never include user-controlled paths.
help.markdown: Use a whitelist of allowed files. Never include user-controlled paths.

fullDescription.text: User-controlled data executed as PHP code or used to select a callable

help.text: Never pass user input to eval()/assert()/callables. Map user choices to a fixed whitelist of callbacks.
help.markdown: Never pass user input to eval()/assert()/callables. Map user choices to a fixed whitelist of callbacks.

fullDescription.text: User-controlled data rendered in HTML output without encoding

help.text: Escape at output: htmlspecialchars($x, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') / esc_html() / esc_attr() / esc_url() depending on the HTML context.
help.markdown: Escape at output: htmlspecialchars($x, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') / esc_html() / esc_attr() / esc_url() depending on the HTML context.

fullDescription.text: User-controlled data in LDAP queries without escaping

help.text: Use ldap_escape() (LDAP_ESCAPE_FILTER / LDAP_ESCAPE_DN) on all user input in LDAP filters and DNs.
help.markdown: Use ldap_escape() (LDAP_ESCAPE_FILTER / LDAP_ESCAPE_DN) on all user input in LDAP filters and DNs.

fullDescription.text: User-controlled data in filesystem operations allows directory traversal

help.text: Use basename() and validate with realpath() against an allowed base directory; reject '..' sequences.
help.markdown: Use basename() and validate with realpath() against an allowed base directory; reject '..' sequences.

fullDescription.text: Uploaded file stored under a user-controlled name without validation of its extension/type

help.text: Validate extension and MIME type against a whitelist, generate a random server-side filename, store outside the webroot.
help.markdown: Validate extension and MIME type against a whitelist, generate a random server-side filename, store outside the webroot.

fullDescription.text: User-controlled data determines target of server-side HTTP requests

help.text: Validate and whitelist target hosts; resolve DNS and block private/loopback IP ranges before requesting. Prefer wp_safe_remote_get().
help.markdown: Validate and whitelist target hosts; resolve DNS and block private/loopback IP ranges before requesting. Prefer wp_safe_remote_get().

fullDescription.text: User-controlled data used in an XPath expression

help.text: Escape quotes in XPath literals or validate against a strict whitelist; prefer parameterized XPath (e.g. variables via DOMXPath::registerPhpFunctions alternatives).
help.markdown: Escape quotes in XPath literals or validate against a strict whitelist; prefer parameterized XPath (e.g. variables via DOMXPath::registerPhpFunctions alternatives).

shortDescription.text: Xxe in $doc->loadXML() (entity loading not explicitly enabled: exploitable on PHP < 8 / with LIBXML_NOENT)

fullDescription.text: XML parsing of user-controlled data (external entities may be resolved if LIBXML_NOENT / entity loading is enabled)

help.text: Never pass LIBXML_NOENT/LIBXML_DTDLOAD; on PHP < 8 call libxml_disable_entity_loader(true). Use LIBXML_NONET.
help.markdown: Never pass LIBXML_NOENT/LIBXML_DTDLOAD; on PHP < 8 call libxml_disable_entity_loader(true). Use LIBXML_NONET.

help.text: Store secrets in environment variables or a secrets manager (never in version control).
help.markdown: Store secrets in environment variables or a secrets manager (never in version control).

fullDescription.text: Session ID set from user-controlled input

help.text: Never set session_id() from user input. Call session_regenerate_id(true) after authentication.
help.markdown: Never set session_id() from user input. Call session_regenerate_id(true) after authentication.

fullDescription.text: User-controlled data in HTTP redirect location

help.text: Validate redirect URL against a whitelist of local paths/trusted domains. In WordPress use wp_safe_redirect() + wp_validate_redirect().
help.markdown: Validate redirect URL against a whitelist of local paths/trusted domains. In WordPress use wp_safe_redirect() + wp_validate_redirect().

fullDescription.text: User-controlled data turned into local variables (extract/parse_str) may overwrite existing variables

help.text: Avoid extract() on request data (or use EXTR_SKIP / EXTR_PREFIX_ALL). Always pass the second argument to parse_str().
help.markdown: Avoid extract() on request data (or use EXTR_SKIP / EXTR_PREFIX_ALL). Always pass the second argument to parse_str().

fullDescription.text: User-controlled data in e-mail headers (CRLF injection, header spoofing)

help.text: Never build mail headers from user input; validate addresses with filter_var(FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL) and strip CR/LF.
help.markdown: Never build mail headers from user input; validate addresses with filter_var(FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL) and strip CR/LF.

help.text: Use password_hash()/password_verify() for passwords, random_bytes()/random_int() for tokens, sodium_* or AES-GCM for encryption.
help.markdown: Use password_hash()/password_verify() for passwords, random_bytes()/random_int() for tokens, sodium_* or AES-GCM for encryption.
